key_insight: AnimationBench provides the first character-centric, flexible benchmark and metric suite designed to evaluate animation-style video generation—capturing stylized appearance, exaggerated motion, and per-character consistency that realistic-video benchmarks miss.
problem_solved: Existing benchmarks are built for realistic videos and use fixed prompts/pipelines, so they cannot reliably evaluate stylized animation, character identity consistency, or open-domain/custom evaluation needs.
method: Curate a diverse animation dataset with character-centric annotations (identity tracks, keypoints, style labels) spanning multiple art styles and exaggerated motions.
Introduce tailored automatic metrics (character-consistency, style-fidelity, motion-exaggeration) complemented by human evaluation protocols.
Provide a flexible, open evaluation pipeline supporting custom prompts, variable-length clips, and reproducible leaderboards/tools for model comparison.
impact: Gives AI/ML practitioners standardized tools to benchmark and improve animation-focused video models, enabling fair comparison and targeted advances in character fidelity, stylization, and motion dynamics.
